name: Invoke Specialist Agent
description: Allows the orchestrator (Willow) to delegate specialized SDLC tasks to dedicated domain agents (Architect, Senior Engineer, QA Synthesizer, SecOps Auditor, DevOps SRE, or custom agents).

agentId.description: Target specialist agent ID (e.g. agent-architect, agent-senior-engineer, agent-qa-synthesizer, agent-secops-auditor, agent-devops-sre, agent-pr-reviewer, or custom ID).

taskDescription.description: Specific task instructions and requirements for the specialist agent.

name: AutoGen Parallel Swarm Orchestration
description: Formulates an autonomous multi-agent plan and executes specialized SDLC agents concurrently using the AutoGen group chat / parallel swarm pattern.

planTitle.description: High-level title of the multi-agent plan.

tasks.description: List of specialized agent assignments to execute concurrently in parallel.

agentId.description: Specialist agent ID (e.g. agent-architect, agent-senior-engineer, agent-qa-synthesizer, agent-secops-auditor, agent-devops-sre).

role.description: Role description for this parallel task.

taskDescription.description: Specific task instructions and requirements for the agent.

name: Read Workspace File
description: Reads file contents with line-numbering and byte offsets from the project workspace.

filePath.description: Relative or absolute path to the target file.

name: Write / Overwrite File
description: Creates a new file or completely replaces the content of an existing file in the authorized repository. Requires human-in-the-loop review before execution.

filePath.description: Destination file path in the workspace.

name: Surgical Patch Editor
description: Performs exact search-and-replace edits within a specified line window in a file.

targetContent.description: Existing exact string block to replace.

name: Directory Explorer
description: Enumerates directory tree, file sizes, and subdirectories.

dirPath.description: Directory path to list. Defaults to workspace root if empty.

name: Create Directory / Folder
description: Creates a new folder or nested directory path in the workspace. Requires human-in-the-loop review before execution.

dirPath.description: Relative workspace path for the folder to create (e.g. 'src/components/analytics' or 'logs').

name: Regex Grep Search
description: Searches codebase for pattern matches, class names, imports, or variable declarations across files.

name: Sandboxed Terminal Runner
description: Executes shell commands (npm test, git, build, linters, scripts) inside the project directory.

name: Automated Test Suite Runner
description: Runs automated unit, integration, and regression test suites, reporting pass/fail breakdowns.

testFilter.description: Optional specific test file or test suite name.

name: Static Security & Secret Scanner
description: Analyzes source code for secret leaks (API keys, tokens), OWASP vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS), and outdated vulnerable dependencies.

targetPath.description: Folder or file to scan. Default scans entire workspace.

name: Git Status & Diff Inspector
description: Inspects git staging status, unstaged diffs, branch metadata, and recent commit history.

detailed.description: Whether to return full line-by-line diffs.

name: MCP: GitHub Issues & PR Manager
description: MCP Tool: Fetches issue descriptions, lists open pull requests, and updates PR review comments via GitHub MCP server.

name: RAG Knowledge Base Search
description: Performs semantic vector & keyword RAG search over ingested documentation, PRDs, architecture guides, and codebase specifications.

query.description: Search query or concept to retrieve relevant context for.

topK.description: Maximum number of relevant knowledge chunks to return (default: 5).

tags.description: Optional list of tags to filter chunks by (e.g. ['architecture', 'security']).

name: Ingest Document to RAG Store
description: Ingests a technical specification, architecture RFC, or documentation into the vector knowledge base for agent retrieval.

content.description: Full document markdown or text content.

name: Inspect Document Version History
description: Retrieves the database version history and diffs for any file modified by the AI harness.

filePath.description: Path to the file to inspect versions for.

name: Rollback File to Version
description: Reverts a workspace file to an earlier version snapshot stored in the database.

name: Chrome Browser & Web App Tester
description: Launches Google Chrome or browser test runner to interact with, test, and verify web application interfaces, form actions, and console errors with Human Approval.

targetUrl.description: Target web application URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5000 or http://localhost:3000).

testScenario.description: Specific functional test scenarios to execute (e.g. calculator addition, form submission, responsive layout).

headless.description: Whether to run headless or open an interactive Chrome window (default false).

name: Live Environment & Server Tester
description: Starts or tests an application server process (e.g. Flask, Node.js, Vite) in the terminal environment with health checks and Human Approval.

command.description: Command to start or test the server (e.g. python app.py or npm test).

checkPort.description: Local TCP port to verify readiness (e.g. 5000).

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for server readiness (default 15).
